text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: W-What an insane run...! Admire Vega... she really is built different!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ngh, Ayabe-san... that's amazing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Incredible...!!

At Nakayama in the year's twilight, Admire Vega
magnificently announced the birth of a new star.

Having drawn tremendous attention, interview requests
began flooding in immediately after the raceâ

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
I'm Otonashi from "Monthly Twinkle"!
Admire Vega-san,
you put on a wonderful performance today.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
If you have any outlook on your next race,
we would love to hear it. What are your thoughts?

Our gazes meet. Just like when we set our sights on the Hopeful Stakes,
she's probably trying to confirm my opinion as her Trainer, just to be sure.

Even so, Admire Vega's goal
is utterly simple.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of my sister who couldn't run, who truly wanted to run...
I want to run... and win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
To the faint pieces of her left inside me.
...I want to give her everything I possibly can.

All for the sake of what she carries on her shoulders.
Reaching even higher—toward an even more dazzling glory.
choice_data_list: Let's go as far as we can, Ayabe.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: To the Classic Triple Crown route.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: ...! If that's the case, our next goal should be—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The Satsuki Sho. ...That is all.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: "Oooooh...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: ......So that's what resolve looks like.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Shoulder what you chose to bear...
Carry out what you set your mind to...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: An unwavering... determination...!!
The next day, clear skies—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road! Narita Top Road!
The race favorite is coming, Narita Top Road!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll see it through! I'll win it all!
I'm going to push all the way to the end!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This is... my resolveeee--!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaargh—!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road in the lead!
Narita Top Road takes the front!
Pulling away by one length—she crosses the line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Narita Top Road is 1st!
Here on Hanshin turf, she has claimed sweet redemption!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I-I did it……!
I did it, I did ittt! Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: Top Road Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Congraaaatulationsーーー!!
That was... that was such an amazing race!
(WAAAAAAAH!!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Nnnrgh...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Alright!!

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text: "WAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hawawawawawa!!
Top, Top, Top Road-saaaan...!!
*sniff* Congratulationssss...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Brava, brava!!
Magnificent, Top Road-san!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
And with this, it's finally a 'trio'.
Things are starting to get interesting, aren't they?!

"Brought together by the fate known as a generation,
the gathered stars begin to shine ever brighter—"

Next in our sights is the Satsuki Sho.
Once the new year begins, the Classic season will kick off.

—...GⅠ races. The Classic Triple Crown.
Satsuki Sho, Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby), Kikuka Sho.
Together with Big Sis...

...Can't wait.
I can't wait, I can't wait...!
I'm looking forward to it—
